preconditions.description: The number of employees n must be between 1 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= pi <= n for pi in managers)
preconditions.description: Each manager index pi must be either -1 or a valid employee index between 1 and n.
The length of the managers list must be equal to the number of employees n.

postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum number of groups required to arrange the employees.
